_comment: Node specs for the machines this benchmark targets, rendered as the specs
table on the site. Descriptive only -- nothing here is computed against,
unlike peak_flops.json, so a wrong value misleads a reader rather than
corrupting a number. Same rule applies anyway: record where it came from
in _source, and say so when a field was not read off an ALCF page.
Per NODE, since that is the unit the benchmark and the allocation both use.

aurora.accelerator: 6× Intel Data Center GPU Max (Ponte Vecchio), 12 tiles
aurora.cpu: 2× Intel Xeon CPU Max (Sapphire Rapids), 104 cores

sophia._source: ALCF Sophia running-jobs page (node count, 40/80 GB split) https://docs.alcf.anl.gov/sophia/queueing-and-running-jobs/running-jobs/ (retrieved 2026-08-11). CPU and memory are the DGX A100 platform spec, corroborated by pbsnodes reporting ncpus=256 and 1tb per node -- NOT read off an ALCF page. Confirm the CPU model before publishing anything that turns on it.
